lead_raw_text:
The structure of YbCdAu crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Yb4Cd4Au4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Au and Cd center has eight geometric neighbors, while each Yb center has twelve neighbors, with all neighbor distances at 3.1064 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between Au and Cd eight-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Yb twelve-vertex polyhedra.
